name: Leo Mendez
source:
Carefree and bursting with energy, Leo Mendez is the ace player of the Soccer Club. This perky go-getter is always keen to try something new, whether it's an interesting class, an exciting game, or a crazy hangout with friends. Leo always says "YES" to everything, even joining Jock Studio, for better or worse!

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]BLits[/url]]
